classes.name: domain-specific response constraints with unmeasured inputs
classes.form: y_d = F_d(x_d,z_d,t); observation maps and cross-domain correspondence unspecified

classes.name: sign-only monotone transfer
classes.form: y=f(x), f nonincreasing on declared support
classes.identifies: conditional weak order reversal; strict reversal additionally requires nonzero slope and a relevant responder

classes.name: linear or saturating monotone refinements
classes.status: observationally equivalent at sampled endpoints after coordinate convention; no refinement selected

classes.name: heterogeneous detection/response mixture
classes.form: observed detection frequency depends on responsiveness, selection and detection sensitivity
classes.status: needed to preserve 4/17 and 13 nonresponders; latent membership not identified
classes.identifies: observed labels, not anatomical responder probability
extra_assumptions: detection threshold and sample selection unknown

classes.name: latent disinhibition versus alternative input change
classes.status: equivalence decomposition, not a fitted physiological model
classes.identifies: no attribution of recall potentiation to α1
extra_assumptions: restriction of Δz would be new evidence or explicit hypothesis

bounded_monotone_note: A bound y(1) <= y(x) <= y(0) for x in [0,1] follows only after C1 and support mapping are assumed; not an empirical neural-amplitude bound.
